description_en: Verifies an SMS verification code and returns the verification result
description_zh: 核验短信验证码并返回核验是否成功的结果
name: CheckSmsVerifyCode

parameters.help_en:
The scheme name. If this parameter is not specified, the value defaults to "Default Scheme". The value can be up to 20 characters in length.
<notice>If the scheme name in the send operation is not empty, make sure that this parameter is not empty and is consistent with the scheme name parameter in the send operation.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
方案名称，如果不填则为“默认方案”。最多不超过20个字符。
<notice>如果发送接口的方案名称不为空，请确保该参数不为空且与发送接口的方案名称参数一致></notice>
parameters.name: scheme_name

parameters.help_en: The country code of the phone number. Default value: 86
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

The TemplateParam field of the SendSmsVerifyCode operation can be configured in two ways:
- {"code":"##code##","min":"5"}
- {"code":"123456","min":"5"}
{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}: The verification code is dynamically generated by the API, and the Alibaba Cloud operation can complete the verification.
{"code":"123456","min":"5"}: The verification code is configured by the user and is not dynamically generated by the API, so the Alibaba Cloud operation cannot perform the verification.
Pass in the corresponding verification code based on your actual configuration
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

SendSmsVerifyCode接口的字段TemplateParam，配置方式有2种：
- {"code":"##code##","min":"5"}
- {"code":"123456","min":"5"}
{"code":"##code##","min":"5"}验证码是api动态生成的，阿里云接口可以完成校验。
{"code":"123456","min":"5"}验证码是用户配置的不是api动态生成，阿里云接口无法校验。
请您按照实际情况传入对应的验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en:
The case sensitivity policy for verification code validation. Valid values:

1: case-insensitive.
2: case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
验证码大小写字母核验策略。取值：

1：不区分大小写。
2：区分大小写
parameters.name: case_auth_policy

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en:
The status code of the API request.

OK indicates that the request is successful.

For other error codes, see Return codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnvs/developer-reference/api-return-code).
<notice>A successful API request does not necessarily mean that the SMS verification code is verified. The SMS verification code verification result is determined only by the return value of the `Model.VerifyResult` parameter.></notice>
Code.description_zh:
接口请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见返回码 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/developer-reference/api-return-code?spm=a2c4g.11174283.0.0.70c5616bkj38Wa)。
<notice>接口请求成功不代表短信验证码核验成功，短信验证码核验结果仅以`Model.VerifyResult`参数返回值为准。></notice>

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

VerifyResult.description_en:
The SMS verification code verification result. Valid values:

PASS: The SMS verification code is verified.

UNKNOWN: The SMS verification code verification failed

短信验证码核验结果。取值：

PASS：短信验证码核验成功。

UNKNOWN：短信验证码核验失败

false: The API call failed.

Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
